logical_findings.finding: Appending other task partitions leaves the stock exact-match selection unchanged when target mapping, ordered pool, payload, demo_seed, query and episode identity are unchanged.
The published selector has no global visual/state nearest-neighbor path; global/soft retrieval is additional implementation, not a switch already verified.
Task identifiers influence routing and seed/cache even when not tokenized directly. Current text-state enters the prompt; numeric state is not passed into the examined MLP action call.
Context and KV cache keys omit bank revision and retrieval rule; comparisons need isolated caches/processes or explicit condition keys.
The cabinet-top BDDL language says drawer, while benchmark task.language is derived from filename and passed by the client.
